summary: IRGC naval forces attacked two vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, setting one ablaze, while Israeli forces destroyed four Hamas and Islamic Jihad weapons warehouses in Gaza. Meanwhile, Yemeni armed forces repelled a Saudi-backed advance toward Bab al-Mandab, inflicting heavy casualties.

IDF and Shin Bet destroyed four weapons warehouses belonging to Hamas and Islamic Jihad across Gaza, eliminating rockets, mortars, and Kalashnikovs. (Source: @almogboker78/18383)
Yemeni armed forces repelled a second Saudi-backed advance toward Bab al-Mandab within hours, causing heavy casualties. (Source: @presstv/210178)

sections.executive_summary: IRGC naval forces attacked two vessels in the Strait of Hormuz within one hour, setting one on fire, marking a significant escalation in maritime threats. Concurrently, Israeli air strikes eliminated four Hamas and Islamic Jihad weapons warehouses across Gaza, degrading militant stockpiles. In Yemen, Houthi-affiliated forces repelled a second Saudi-backed ground offensive toward the strategic Bab al-Mandab strait, inflicting heavy casualties.

points: The Pentagon updated its official casualty count for the war against Iran to 21 killed and 865 wounded as of October 9, adding two deaths and four wounded since the previous report. (Source: @SharghDaily/188421)
